card.name: Angle and perpendicular orientation words
card.fires_on: The word angle, or perpendicular (including its start, perpend-), where something is described as tilted or oriented relative to a surface, line or axis. Seen in physics, geometry and instructions for inserting needles or spikes.

modes.label: Angle to something
modes.description: The word angle after at an, a or a number, followed by to or with a reference line.

modes.label: Perpendicular orientation
modes.description: The word perpendicular, or perpend-, giving a right-angle direction relative to a surface or plane.
modes.example: insert the spike as close to<< perpendicular>> (90 degrees) as possible.

card.writes: It seems to push the output away from angle-related words and toward other continuations, since the promoted tokens are angle words in several languages.
card.plain: It marks words that say how something is tilted or turned relative to another line or surface, such as angle or perpendicular.
